final.summary: The batch's wastewater was held in the equalization tank during the planned ETP stop 14:10-16:55 and then treated. Outfall pH stayed near neutral 7.11-7.78 and conductivity remained stable 5031-5994 uS/cm over the treatment interval 2026-10-13 14:00 to 2026-10-14 18:00. Power versus load shows observed mean 57.1 kW versus expected 58.1 kW with only 2.1% of points below band. Tank level rose from 0.41 to 0.66 fraction while ETP inflow and outfall flow were zero during the stop, and water balance closes within tolerance.

Wastewater bypassed ETP to outfall during stop
Aeration cut with normal inflow, untreated discharge
Groundwater added to outfall diluting measurements

key_evidence.why: Outfall pH stays 7.11-7.78, no alkaline spike indicating untreated discharge.
ETP power at standby 3.7-4.2 kW during stop, confirming shutdown.
Tank level rises 0.41 to 0.66 while outfall flow zero, showing water held.
Power matches inflow load across treatment interval, indicating aeration ran when ETP was on.
Tank balance closes within tolerance with unaccounted 11.6 m3, no evidence of bypass.

final.scope_line: Based on flow, power, pH and conductivity records for 2026-10-13 14:00 to 2026-10-14 18:00. Does not measure every pollutant.
final.limitations: No accredited lab BOD results available for the treatment interval. S2 and S4a show flat zero readings 14:10-16:50, indicating meter flatness during stop but not a replay. Factory logbook and maintenance record are claims, not physical evidence.

steps.why: Check water balance during stop to confirm tank absorbed inflow and no unaccounted loss.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
